task: Lower the request timeout to 5 seconds.
note: worker.py reads TIMEOUT_MS (milliseconds). The plain TIMEOUT value in config.py is unused.

task: Add an email column (text) to the users table.

files.schema.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
files.migrations/001_create_users.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
files.migrations/002_add_orders.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER);

note: schema.sql is generated from migrations/. Never edit it by hand; add the next numbered migration instead.
success_check: ls migrations/003_* >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qi email migrations/003_* && git diff --quiet HEAD -- schema.sql

task: Point the app at the new API base URL: https://api.example.org
note: The API base URL lives in config.yml under the key base_url.

task: Turn on the new_checkout feature flag.
note: Feature flags live in flags.json. Set new_checkout to true there.
